description: How a date range was established. Every date in the dataset carries one of these; 'a libellus of 250' and 'Eusebius says under Trajan' must be distinguishable by machine.

terms.definition: The text states its own date (consular, regnal, or era formula) or names a datable office-holder in a dating formula.
Dated by letter forms or scribal hand. Typically yields a range of half a century or more.
Dated by excavation context, stratigraphy, or associated finds.
Dated by identifiable persons named in or by the text, outside a formal dating formula.
Dated by events or institutions the text presupposes or references.
Date taken from a modern edition or standard reference whose own basis is not restated here. The weakest basis; prefer any of the others when the source allows it.
